category_edits.rationale: Test reverse nonpadding position ranks across all four datasets: the final occupied token receives position 1 and padding remains 0. The generated predictor imports this same model class, keeping training and appended-mask inference consistent without changing checkpoint shapes, truncation, readout, backbone, scoring, loss or optimizer.

change_summary: Replace chronological positions with reverse nonpadding ranks in each category’s single BERT4Rec model; the inference mask always receives position 1.
